title: New family registration
subtitle: Register your family with the Sabha. The Sabha office reviews every application.

success.title: Registration submitted
success.body: Thank you. The Sabha will review your application. Your membership number is created automatically once it is approved, and you will be notified.

addMemberHint: Name, photo, date of birth, relation, mobile
noLoginNote: Family members do not get a login by default. You can request one later from Me › My family.
docsHint: Upload an address proof and any other document the Sabha asks for (photo or PDF).
consent: I confirm the details are correct and agree that the Sabha may show them to members as per my privacy settings.
verifyAgain: Please verify your mobile number again in step 1.

after.title: After you submit
after.body: Your status shows Pending until the Sabha approves. You then get your membership number and can sign in with your mobile number.

photoHint: A clear, recent photo (JPG, PNG or WebP)
verified: Verified by OTP · not registered before
otpHint: We will send an OTP by SMS to confirm this number.
mustVerify: Please verify your mobile number with the OTP.

status.title: Check registration status
status.subtitle: Enter the mobile number you registered with and confirm it with an OTP.
status.pendingNote: Your application is being reviewed by the Sabha office.
status.rejectedNote: Your application was not approved. Reason: {{remarks}}

admin.title: Registrations
admin.subtitle: Review new family applications. Approving assigns the next membership number and creates the head's login.
admin.head: Head of family
admin.approveBody: {{name}}'s family becomes an active member and gets the next membership number.
admin.rejectBody: Tell {{name}} why the application cannot be approved.
